usage: jbus flow nudges [-h] [--title TITLE] [--store STORE] [--json]
                        since until

Definition: a nudge is a message from Josh in a home thread that restarts work
that had stopped without a decision of his: it tells the home to carry on, or
asks why work stopped, and it answers no question the home asked him. A
message carried to a second home counts once. Approvals, answers, status
questions and new work are not nudges.

positional arguments:
  since          from this time, the user's zone with none
  until          to this time, as since

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE  threads whose title is like this, as SQL's like (default:
                 'home: %', every home)
  --store STORE  T3 Code's store, opened read-only
  --json         print the count and list as JSON, as jbus flow --json does
                 before nudges
